overall: The AG found the Board did not violate the Open Meeting Law: the February 28, 2011 emergency meeting was justified and properly noticed, and no unlawful deliberation or serial communication was found. No remedy ordered; matter closed.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the Board improperly held its February 28, 2011 emergency meeting, questioning whether a valid emergency justified it.
allegations.key_passage: We find that the Board was justified in holding an emergency meeting on February 28, 2011 and followed the proper steps to post notice ahead of the meeting.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged Board members deliberated about the allegations against her before the posted meeting, through the Chair's discussions with other members.
allegations.key_passage: Because Chairman Ouellette conferred with only one other Board member prior to making the decision to hold an emergency meeting, the discussion did not reach a quorum, and thus was not a deliberation.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the Town Administrator facilitated a serial deliberation among a quorum of Board members when he contacted them about the emergency meeting.
allegations.key_passage: Here, it was appropriate for the Town Administrator to contact the Board members, tell them details of the meeting including the time and location, as well as the general purpose.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the Board improperly discussed sensitive matters in open session without her waiver, rather than in executive session.
allegations.key_passage: The Board did not need a waiver or consent from Ms. Melville to discuss allegations against her in open session.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged Board members deliberated outside the posted meeting on hiring counsel, preparing documents, and having her served with notice.
allegations.key_passage: After reviewing statements by the Board members provided to this office, we find no evidence that any deliberations occurred outside of the posted February 28, 2011 emergency meeting.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged a Board member's visit to Town Hall during the Chair's discussions amounted to a serial deliberation among a quorum.
allegations.key_passage: It does not appear a serial deliberation occurred here, because Mr. Hnatonko was only informed of the possibility of a future emergency meeting, and did not participate in any substantive discussion.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged Board members agreed before the meeting to release documents about her to local news media.
allegations.key_passage: We find no evidence that Board released these documents prior to the meeting, nor do we find any evidence that there was any discussion between and among a quorum of the Board prior to the meeting regarding release of such documents.
